verses.t: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast
verses.pickthall: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate

verses.t: And We removed from you your burden
verses.pickthall: And eased thee of the burden

verses.t: Which had weighed upon your back
And raised high for you your repute
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease
verses.pickthall: But lo! with hardship goeth ease

verses.t: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]
verses.pickthall: So when thou art relieved, still toil

verses.t: And to your Lord direct [your] longing
verses.pickthall: And strive to please thy Lord
